Name: The Act of Cooking - a Love of Cooking addon
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
[size=5][center]
[url=https://ibb.co/v45cbt2B][img]https://i.ibb.co/XxBW9wm4/NAO.png[/img][/url]
 [/center][center]This mod acts as an addon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]﻿, bringing a brand new vanilla-style cooking minigame to Stardew Valley! Instead of just picking a recipe, [b]you'll handle each ingredient step by step.[/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/8g3fn4xQ/cookingminigame.png[/img]

Here, timing is everything! [b]Click when the arrow reaches the green zone, or you might end up burning your dish[/b]. The pace picks up with every ingredient, so [b]upgrading your frying pan for a bigger green zone[/b] might be a good idea.[/center][/size][size=5][center] [/center][/size][center][size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/rfm2tQ9S/cookingminigame2.png[/img]

When the minigame ends, enjoy the fruits of your hard labor: a hot, steamy meal with a [b]taste rating based on your cooking skill!

[/b][/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/Df9JFts2/panefficiency.png[/img]
[size=5][b] 
[/b][/size][size=5]Oh, and don’t forget: [b]the better your frying pan, the more you can cook in a single minigame.[/b]
[b][size=5][b] 
[/b][/size][/b][/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/xKVQ9F8Q/sv-Its-simple-Just-follow-the-recipe-as-it-appears-on-the-screen.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[size=5][b][size=5][b]
[/b][/size] 
[/b]This mod was made with much care and is the result of months of work. I made it to be as vanilla-friendly as possible and to [b]work with any recipe[/b] (including modded ones), [b]supports multiplayer,[/b] and is fully [b]compatible with controllers.[/b][/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: Fixed issue with the drinks animation
